findings.title: Received knowledge remains dependent authority
findings.claim: The servant designation frames the received mercy and taught knowledge as capacities held in submission, so the resulting authority is derivative rather than self-authorizing.
findings.mechanism: The focus carriers عَبْدًا and عِبَادِنَا name servanthood before the paired bestowal and teaching carriers. The wider servant-status and conveyed-knowledge contacts return through those focus words and change the gift from a possession claim into received authority.
findings.reader_payoff: The unnamed servant can be perceived as one who acts from what has been given, not as an autonomous owner of the knowledge that guides the acts.
findings.containment: The ordinary reading remains that a servant was found, granted mercy, and taught knowledge. This adds dependent agency without identifying the servant, claiming infallibility, or explaining every later act through the servant designation alone.

epistemic.reason: Exact focus anchors and a trusted publication directly support the relation; the duplicate legacy walk and retrospective support are retained as qualification, while the global consequence remains an interpretation of the contacted evidence.

branch_activations.activation: The wider servant relation contacts the focus's naming-before-gifts structure, making the gifts operate through submission rather than become self-owned authority.
branch_activations.resulting_reading: The recipient's authority is received and dependent, not autonomous.

branch_activations.resulting_reading: The taught knowledge carries derivative authority and a boundary around what the recipient may claim as his own.

findings.title: Near source, bounded access
findings.claim: The source constructions make the taught knowledge source-near while the wider same-surah pattern keeps access to it mediated rather than immediate or self-owned.
findings.mechanism: The candidate's unresolved source-boundary branch is carried by the focus phrase لَدُنَّا. The 18:10 source-nearness parallel, 18:19's deferral of disputed knowledge, and the supplied 18:66–70 retrospective record contact that phrase and change simple proximity into proximity with a learning boundary.
findings.reader_payoff: Nearness of source no longer implies instant possession: received knowledge can still arrive through teaching, restraint, agreement, and controlled disclosure.
findings.containment: The ordinary source meaning remains intact. No unresolved branch gloss or facet is invented, no causal relation between mercy and knowledge is asserted, and the whole pericope is not reduced to this image.

epistemic.reason: The focus source phrase and the reader-walk nominations are supplied, but root_004482/B002 has no independent registry gloss, facet, or resolved focus occurrence; the same-surah connection rows provide bounded contextual contact.
